## What this site is

This site hosts the interactive materials for **7002LBSAI Research Methods in Analytics** — slide decks and in-class tools that need to run as live web pages rather than static files.

**Your Canvas module is the main hub** for the schedule, the textbook, datasets, notebooks, recordings, and assessment information. Come here only when a Canvas page links you to a specific tool or interactive slide deck.
